rows.en: Well? How's Dan doing?

We took him to the TDF-affiliated hospital…

He's fully conscious, but he needs strict bed rest for a while!

I'm planning to have him get a thorough examination.
I see… Take good care of him.

Yes, this is the Ultra Garrison…

What!?
What is it?
In major cities across the country, buildings are attacking…
Hey, hey, Amagi! Buildings are being attacked, you mean! Someone's attacking the cities!
All right, let's sortie anyway!

Hey… from the looks of it, nothing seems different, does it?

Maybe… it's another prank?

No, but… would anyone tell a lie like that all over the country at once?

I hear the Science Patrol and MAT are scattered across the regions too, busy dealing with it.
Still… this town sure has a lot of strange-shaped buildings… …!?

Damn it, what!?

I see… the buildings really are attacking?
There may be people still inside the buildings who didn't get out in time! Attack carefully!
Roger!
"Observer 340… no, let me call you Ultraseven, as you are known on Earth!"
"That voice… Zoffy?"

"Your body has taken a great deal of damage from your fierce battles with the invaders so far…

Staying on Earth any longer is extremely dangerous! Ultraseven… the time has come for you to return to the M78 Nebula!"

"But… there's no end to the invaders targeting this beautiful planet!

If I go home, what will happen to the Earth!?"

"Ultraseven…

right now you should think of yourself! Staying on Earth means death."
"Can't I go back to my original body?"
"For that… you must return to the M78 Nebula! Your body is not like a human's."
"I can't go back now! Something terrible is about to happen on Earth! I can't just abandon it!"

"Then… let me give you just one warning!

You must not fight and use up any more energy!

You won't even be able to return to the M78 Nebula! You absolutely must not transform!!"
Captain! Dan… Dan has disappeared from the hospital!
What!? Dan has?
In that condition, where on earth could he go?
Soga!!

Attention, Terrestrial Defense Force!

The Terrestrial Defense Force must surrender to us, Alien Guts, immediately!

If you surrender to us, Alien Guts, we will permit you to migrate to the underground cities of Mars and guarantee the livelihood of all mankind!

We have powerful underground missiles! You Earthlings have a strong defense in the sky and the sea, but underground you're completely defenseless!

If you do not surrender, we will regrettably launch a simultaneous attack on the major cities of every nation and carry out an operation to exterminate all 6.2 billion humans!
Damn it… an operation to exterminate 6.2 billion, he says! They're mocking us!

Of course, we'll give you time to think… But we won't let up on our attacks in the meantime!

The longer you delay your decision, the more the damage around the world will spread! Hah hah hah…
Damn it… I'd rather die than live like a mole in some underground city on Mars.
Wait! Calm down, both of you…

Everyone!

This is indeed… the greatest invasion in history, with the lives of all 6.2 billion humans at stake! We must not act rashly!

Just as they said… underground, we're completely defenseless!

If they fire underground missiles at us, there's no way to stop them!
Captain Kiriyama! I want the Ultra Garrison to find the enemy's missile base!

We'll… gather the leaders of every nation and put on a show of holding a countermeasures meeting!

We'll drag it out as long as we can, so find that enemy base somehow!

You heard him?

Furuhashi, Amagi, both of you find that missile base immediately!

Roger!

First, let's clean up these guys!
"If they give me a thorough examination, they'll find out I'm an alien. Forgive me, Anne…"
The Moscow branch has gone silent!
Next, the London branch… the Berlin and Sydney branches can't be reached either!
Did they fire underground missiles?
No response from the Washington branch! Cairo branch… No good, no response there either!

Well, no answer yet?

If there's no answer in 30 minutes, the Far East branch is next! 30 more minutes! YES or NO, that's the answer I want…
Captain Kiriyama! Haven't you found the enemy base yet!?

Well…

It's slow going, since we're also dealing with the building-shaped robots appearing everywhere.
Director… what if we recall the security team stationed near that space fortress?
No… they'll never make it in 30 minutes! At this rate, there's no time for any countermeasures meeting.
At this point… surrender may be unavoidable! The cities are in total chaos.

The North Pole branch… has gone silent!

All that remains now are the Paris General Headquarters and this Far East branch.
Captain! We've found the enemy missile base under Mt. Echizen!
The valley between it and Mt. Yobuko was the entrance!

Well done!

Director! Every second counts!

Let's load the Magmalizer with a time bomb and send it straight into the enemy base on autopilot!
Very well… Get ready at once!

Please wait!

Soga's being held captive in that enemy base! What about him?
What are you saying? At a time like this, we can't worry about one man's life!
I'll go rescue him!
That's a bad idea! If the enemy spots you, everything will be for nothing!
But…

Give it up… I understand how much Soga means to you!

But he's a member of the Ultra Garrison too! He'd put all mankind before his own life…
Magmalizer, launch!!
I have to save Soga…
"Wait! You must not transform! You won't be able to return to the M78 Nebula!! And not only that, even your life…"
Dan! I finally found you!
Why did you run away? Hey? Answer me!!

Anne… I… I'm…

not human! I'm Ultraseven, from the M78 Nebula!
Surprised, aren't you?

No… Human or alien, Dan is still Dan, isn't he!

Even if you're Ultraseven…
Thank you, Anne…
I have to go back to the M78 Nebula!
When the sun sets in the western sky… a single light will fly off into space! That will be me.
Goodbye, Anne!
Wait, Dan!! Don't go!
Soga's in danger! Dwah…
The time bomb has exploded… The missile base was successfully destroyed!
Did we get it!?
"Soga…"

…!?

It's Ultraseven!

Ah… Hey, Soga!

You're safe? Soga!
Yeah… Ultraseven saved me.

U15075-U15083/U15123: telepathic dialogue in 『』 rendered in double quotes.
U15075: 恒点観測員340号 rendered 'Observer 340'.
U15088: 地球防衛軍 rendered 'Terrestrial Defense Force' (the TDF).
U15111/U15112: 越前岳 / 呼子岳 rendered Mt. Echizen / Mt. Yobuko.
U15113: マグマライザー rendered 'Magmalizer' (not in glossary).
U15134: Ultraseven's transformation cry デュワッ rendered 'Dwah…'.
